description: Context and conservation of the one stringent non-consensus gataE hit, plus hit density of all three loci against genomic expectation
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def rd(c): return open(f"out/{c}.fa").read().strip()
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))
sp=rd("gatae_win"); TSS=20000
off=TSS+36541
print("context around the gataE +36541 MA0646.2 hit (minus strand):")
print(" ",sp[off-30:off+40])
print(" rc:",rc(sp[off-30:off+40]))
# site-centred conservation test for this 8-mer core
K=10; FL=150
def kset(s): return {s[i:i+K] for i in range(len(s)-K+1) if "N" not in s[i:i+K]}
def shared(a,b): return len(kset(a)&(kset(b)|kset(rc(b))))
lv=rd("Lvar_gatae_big"); q=sp[off-FL:off+FL+10]
occ=[m.start() for m in re.finditer("(?=ATACGGGTAG)",lv)]+[m.start() for m in re.finditer("(?="+rc("ATACGGGTAG")+")",lv)]
best=max([shared(q,lv[max(0,o-FL):o+FL+10]) for o in occ],default=-1)
rng=np.random.default_rng(3); null=np.array([shared(q,lv[p:p+2*FL+10]) for p in rng.integers(0,len(lv)-2*FL-11,400)])
print(f"  Lv occurrences of ATACGGGTAG: {len(occ)}; best shared 10-mers {best}; null median {np.median(null)}, max {null.max()}")

d=pd.read_csv("out/pwm_density.csv")
fig,(ax1,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6),sharey=False)
order=["gcm","pks1","gatae"]; cols={"gcm":"#c0392b","pks1":"#c0392b","gatae":"#e67e22"}
mats=["MA0767.2","MA0646.2","MA1840.2"]; wdt=0.26
for ax,(col,lab,ttl) in zip([ax1,ax2],
        [("ratio4","observed / expected hits","relaxed threshold p = 1e-4:\nall three loci sit at genomic background"),
         ("ratio5","observed / expected hits","stringent threshold p = 1e-5:\nonly the two loci with validated sites are enriched")]):
    for i,m in enumerate(mats):
        sub=d[d.matrix==m].set_index("locus").loc[order]
        ax.bar(np.arange(3)+(i-1)*wdt, sub[col].values, wdt, label=m+" ("+sub.tf.iloc[0]+")")
    ax.axhline(1,color="k",ls="--",lw=1)
    ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(["gcm\n51 kb","pks1\n34.5 kb","gataE\n57.2 kb"])
    ax.set_ylabel(lab); ax.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10,loc="left"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
